This deal follows several other strategic acquisitions by McKesson and highlights the continued activity in the life sciences sector.

stories.title: Lancium Adds NVIDIA as Investor and Partner, Targeting Gigawatt AI Factories Across a 15GW Pipeline
stories.summary: Lancium has announced a strategic collaboration and investment from NVIDIA to develop large-scale accelerated computing infrastructure for AI factories. This partnership will integrate NVIDIA's hardware and software into Lancium's data center campuses, which currently manage 4GW of leased capacity and have a 15GW development pipeline.
